title: Multiplayer/Emotes
wikitext: Emotes are short actions that the player character can act out, which will also show the emote over the players head in a thought bubble. Emotes can be activated by typing it into [[Multiplayer#Chat|chat]] using the emote command (/emote ), or by pressing the '''Emote Menu''' keybind (Default {{key|Y}}), and on controller Hold Right Thumb Stick. {|class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; border-collapse: collapse;" !colspan="14"|Emotes |- |[[File:Emote Happy.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Sad.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Heart.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Exclamation.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Note.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Sleep.png|center]] |- style="text-align: center;" |Happy |Sad |Heart |Exclamation |Note |Sleep |- |[[File:Emote Game.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Question.png|center]] |[[File:Emote X.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Pause.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Blush.png|center]] |[[File:Emote Angry.png|center]] |- style="text-align: center;" |Game |Question |X |Pause |Blush |Angry |- |[[File:Emote Yes.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote No.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote Sick.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote Laugh.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote Surprised.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote Hi!.gif|center]] |- style="text-align: center;" |Yes |No |Sick |Laugh |Surprised |Hi! |- |[[File:Emote Taunt.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote Uh.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote Music.gif|center]] |[[File:Emote Jar.gif|center]] |- style="text-align: center;" |Taunt |Uh |Music |Jar |- |} * '''Blush''', '''Jar''', '''Music''' and '''Taunt''' are hidden from the emote menu until you type them as a command, such as /emote jar in the chat window.
